# YOOV WORK | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Local cloud-end HR/office management products covering personnel, remuneration, shift attendance and mobile office. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition boundary | Cross-border remuneration, complex group privileges and large-scale interfaces need to be confirmed; some of the information is released earlier and should be based on current demonstrations and contracts. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, award or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Cross-border remuneration, complex group competencies and large-scale interfaces need to be confirmed; some of the information is released earlier, based on current demonstrations and contracts. |
